method.words: THE METHOD of household_return_daily (contract 0.1.0): household daily return r_t over the accounts with rows on both the previous household date and day t, external flows removed; ACCOUNT_MISSING and NO_PRIOR_VALUE days are null, never zero. A window return is the product of (1 + r_t) over the trading days after the window's opening anchor up to and including as_of, minus one; it is null when the household has no row on the anchor or on any window day, or any r_t is null. Anchors: the last trading day before the window start (qtd, ytd, last_12_months; lib/trading_calendar.py); since_inception opens on the household's first date in the read, so its claim is inferred: the read reaches back only to the earliest partition read. An account's window return is the product of (1 + total_return_daily) over the same days, complete only with a non-null row on each day. Comparable: household return not null and at least one complete member. Range: the minimum and maximum of the complete members' returns; within means inside the range widened by 1e-9 each side; an outside gap is the distance to the nearer end, binned in basis points. One-account households: the distinct households with a window where both the household and the account are complete; max absolute gap over those windows. Reads: LIST of the account gold date partitions (newest 900 read when more; every object of each read partition read); LIST and one GET of the newest crosswalk partition.
